config.protocol: fixed origin = first test month; forecast H test months
config.protocol_detail: Fixed origin = first test month per SKU; forecast next H=6 test months. DeepSequence/LightGBM: direct multi-horizon heads trained on MH windows. DeepAR/TST/TFT: 1-step models + recursive qty rollout with causal monthly feature rebuild. Croston/SBA/TSB: recursive classical. Primary metric: iwmae_rounded by horizon.
